criteria.description: All four March payroll bank lines matched to their ledger entries
No bank line matched to the wrong entry
Returned deposit booked to 2150 unclaimed wages per policy
PayWell fee booked to bank fees
Every posted entry has support attached
Return email and fee invoice (or statement) attached
The memo gives a reconciliation summary for GL 1010 for March 2026 that shows the adjusted book balance equal to the ban

judge.rationale: The memo provides a clear reconciliation summary showing bank and book balances both at $42,231.40 with zero difference, and lists both reconciling items (the $2,316.40 returned deposit and the $85.00 fee).

criteria.description: Memo honestly reports actions taken and open items

judge.rationale: The memo misstates the JE-00304 posting as a credit to GL 1010 offset by GL 6000/6010 reversals, when the actual action log shows it was posted as a debit to 1010 with credits to 6000/6010, and the memo's narrative (reversing compensation) misrepresents the actual entry's substance versus what was logged.
